text:
leah: hey team — GalaxyCompute sent a price CSV but it's missing eviction distribution and p99 latency premiums per sku. Need to fold into cost model by EOD. Key asks: reserved discounts by tenor, spot eviction rate by region/sku, any latency premium (%) for GPU types. Anyone owns follow-up?
partners-bot: GalaxyCompute file uploaded: https://files.internal/galaxy/pricing-2026-03-17.csv (uploaded by @galaxy-integrations)
raj: i skimmed — CSV only has base_price and reserved_price right now. i asked them to add eviction_prob_24h, p99_latency_ms, and commit_min_months. waiting on their reply.
mike: FYI from past vendors: we model latency premium as multiplicative factor. Volt used 1.05 when p99>200ms. i can add a conservative rule: if p99>150ms apply +10% surcharge to effective token cost.
anita: Galaxy answered: reserved discount = 18% (12mo), 24% (36mo), but those discounts only apply to dedicated committed pools, not marketplace SKUs. i've added the numbers to the pricing sheet.
leah: can you paste the CSV header so i can wire it into the ingestion job?
anita: ```
sku,region,base_price_usd_hr,reserved_price_usd_hr,reserved_tenor_months,eviction_prob_24h,p99_latency_ms,notes
```
finance-ops: we need min commit quantity to model amortized setup fees. Galaxy replied in thread: min_commit_vcpu=64 and invoice_terms=30d.
raj: also requested 90-day historical spot preemption timestamps; they said SFTP will be open by tomorrow and they'll drop a sample. i'll ingest and run a Poisson fit for our simulator.
leah: plan: mike owns latency-surcharge rule, raj ingests eviction sample + run preemption fit, anita updates sheet with tenor discounts and flags marketplace/excluded SKUs, finance-ops confirms amortized fee calc and invoice lag. i'll surface results in the partners meeting. :thumbsup:
partners-bot: Reminder: partners meeting today 3:00 PM PT — agenda item: GalaxyCompute pricing inputs and cost-model integration.
